notes.title: Annie: Last Hope – Re-release & Update Notes
notes.notes: [p]Following a round of optimization and adjustments, [i]Annie: Last Hope[/i] will soon be available for purchase again. The latest update includes the following improvements:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Added Japanese language support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New aiming guide feature[/b], which can be enabled in the game settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance optimizations[/b], including reduced memory usage and improved frame rates[/p][/*][/olist][p]We sincerely thank all players who have supported [i]Annie: Last Hope[/i]. We will continue to update and improve the game to bring you an even better gameplay experience.[/p]

notes.title: Release Notes V1.1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fix the monster will fall off the bridge at Little Mexico 
- Fix process jam about the fight of Tire in Forest.
- Fix the monster may be abnormal move at Little Mexico
- Fix strange life volume display of Man in Black at Supermarket
- New save point before the Fight of Tire
- CG can be skipped when you reborn in Fight of Giant Tire
- Ammo box will be more evident in Fight of Truck
- Refine the Grammar of English localization
- Weaken the bow's range
- New invisible wall in Level Lift
